bio.text: Lisa Blunt Rochester was elected to the U.S. Senate from Delaware in 2024, after four terms in the U.S. House of Representatives as Delaware's at-large member, first elected in 2016.
She was born in Philadelphia and raised in Wilmington, Delaware.
She previously served in the cabinets of Delaware Governors Tom Carper and Ruth Ann Minner as Secretary of Labor, Deputy Secretary of Health and Social Services, and State Personnel Director.
She pursued a master's degree at the University of Delaware.
